## Purpose

Describe the bug, documentation improvement or predeclared research hypothesis.

## Changes and scope

State whether numerical behavior, dependencies, research evidence or only documentation changes.

## Verification

List exact commands actually run, outcomes, failures and checks not performed.
For a numerical change, link the prior protocol, baseline/control comparisons and causal checks.
Do not describe archived results as fresh runs or a synthetic demo as benchmark reproduction.

## Checklist

- [ ] I retained negative findings and disclosed post-result selection.
- [ ] I did not add private data, credentials or externally restricted material.
- [ ] I checked documentation links and preserved applicable license notices.
- [ ] I explained any numerical, manifest or tolerance changes rather than silently updating expectations.
